create_HuggingFaceDataset: create a HuggingFaceDataset instance from a Hugging Face dataset URL with optional transforms and class labels
download_dataset_from_hub: download a Hugging Face dataset from a repo URL and save it to disk as a cached dataset
load_txt_file_from_hub: load and parse a text file from a Hugging Face dataset repo, cleaning whitespace and placeholders
filter_dataset_by_subset: filter a Hugging Face dataset by key-value subset constraints with parallel processing
get_item_with_images_and_labels: retrieve an item from the dataset returning images, targets, and sample identifiers
